webgpuWidgetsEnabled — the layer kill-switch. The WebGPU widget mounts (worker OffscreenCanvas route OR in-page) only run under ?debug=webgpuWidgets:active; every other state keeps the proven WebGL/CSS renderers authoritative. Re-parsed per call so tests and debug toggles flip without a reload.

Returns

boolean

True when the WebGPU widget layer may mount.
